skills.name: Basic fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting numerators of fractions sharing a common denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Finding the Least Common Denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Whole number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole number part to resolve a negative fractional difference.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction or mixed number's fractional part to its lowest terms.
